proves.claim: lagLine for a checkout behind main names the commits behind and the base age and says submit composes current main; the words merge main before you build are gone.

cli.io-next-lag.no-merge-instruction.why: Without it, a seat keeps being told to merge main before each build, which submit already does itself.

proves.claim: A next that hands out an item in its own item folder prints no lag line for the seat checkout, and a next that hands out nothing still prints it.

cli.io-next-lag.item-folder-silent.why: Without it, a seat is told it lags main right beside an item folder that was cut from current main.
